notes: PUBLIC STORYBOARDS ONLY. No finished videos, human-recorded narration or YouTube upload. Scene dialogue is concise placeholder audio and should be expanded/timed before long-form production.
source_verification: Official announcement facts independently reviewed for creative draft; require separate final accuracy verification before release

episodes.title: OpenAI on Google Cloud: what really changes?
episodes.viewer_question: Does the partnership mean Gemini is replaced and everyone gets OpenAI models for free?
episodes.learning_outcome: Understand the difference between a cloud model marketplace and consumer AI products, and why availability needs checking.
episodes.repeatable_takeaway: Before expecting a new AI feature, check its official access status, pricing, audience and product context.

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult woman, navy jacket with thin cyan piping, shoulder-length dark hair
characters.voice_style: Warm natural conversational voice with clear short explanations

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult man, spectacles, charcoal hoodie, curious expressions
characters.voice_style: Curious English beginner asking one question at a time

shots.location: Futuristic but physically grounded 3D studio with desk, windows, shelves and lit equipment
shots.visual_explanation: Two speaking characters meet beside a physical laptop; no logos imply an official app interface.
shots.learner_payoff: Collaboration does not mean one AI replaces another.

dialogue.speaker: jay
dialogue.text: Did OpenAI just replace Gemini on Google Cloud?

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: No. This is a new choice for certain cloud customers.

object_interactions.action: tilts the laptop toward Asha to point at the question

shots.location: Modern 3D cloud-workshop with tangible glass-front model cabinets and a presenter desk
shots.visual_explanation: Asha opens a model-shop cabinet, using physical model cubes to make model choice easy to visualize.
shots.learner_payoff: Think of a cloud model marketplace as a shelf of choices.

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: Think of a workshop where developers can choose different AI tools.

dialogue.speaker: jay
dialogue.text: So the workshop is the platform, not the model itself?

object_interactions.action: slides open the glass cabinet showing labeled example model cubes

shots.location: Modern 3D cloud-workshop with tangible glass-front model cabinets and a presenter desk
shots.visual_explanation: Camera orbits as both characters move a generic model cube into a glowing workflow track; illustrative technology.
shots.learner_payoff: Developers choose a model for a specific workflow.

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: OpenAI says its models and Codex workflows are coming to Model Garden.

dialogue.speaker: jay
dialogue.text: So a team may choose a model for a task?

object_interactions.action: picks up the model cube and places it onto a modular workflow track
touches the next workflow tile and watches a signal move

shots.location: Modern 3D cloud-workshop with tangible glass-front model cabinets and a presenter desk
shots.visual_explanation: Moving glass cubes represent an enterprise environment, with no fictional claims about live personal Gemini features.
shots.learner_payoff: Business availability differs from personal app access.

dialogue.speaker: jay
dialogue.text: Does my personal Gemini app get everything today?

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: No. The announcement is about planned cloud access, not automatic free consumer access.

object_interactions.action: rotates the enterprise workspace tower beside the workflow track

shots.location: Futuristic but physically grounded 3D studio with desk, windows, shelves and lit equipment
shots.visual_explanation: Clearly labeled illustration of a fact-check card showing categories, not simulated official Google Cloud UI.
shots.learner_payoff: Check rollout, pricing and access before attempting.

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: Before trying it, check availability, marketplace pricing and the data controls.

dialogue.speaker: jay
dialogue.text: So we should verify what is live, not guess from headlines.

shots.location: Futuristic but physically grounded 3D studio with desk, windows, shelves and lit equipment
shots.visual_explanation: Both characters place final fact and caution cubes on the desk, then camera dollies back.
shots.learner_payoff: Partnership means additional cloud model choice, not a free upgrade.

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: Remember: more options for cloud developers, not instant free access for everyone.

dialogue.speaker: jay
dialogue.text: Got it. Check the product details first.

object_interactions.action: sets a glowing choice cube onto the center of the desk

episodes.title: हजारों AI एजेंट और 32 मिनट का ब्रेन डेटा
episodes.viewer_question: How can thousands of AI agents help scientists analyze millions of mouse brain cells?
episodes.learning_outcome: Explain parallel research agents, their role in finding testable biological ideas, and the need for lab verification.
episodes.repeatable_takeaway: When scientific AI news appears, separate the speed of analysis from experimentally validated discoveries and treatments.

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult man, navy shirt, light stubble, cyan cuff accents
characters.voice_style: Conversational Hindi male storyteller with measured pauses

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult woman, teal top, round glasses and hair bun
characters.voice_style: Curious Hindi woman raising practical questions without jargon

shots.location: 3D neuroscience laboratory with a cellular hologram and workbenches
shots.visual_explanation: Two scientists face a wall of data cubes, expressing how a huge experiment becomes difficult to examine manually.
shots.learner_payoff: Large datasets can hide interesting questions.

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: इतने बड़े डेटा में वैज्ञानिक नए सुराग कैसे ढूँढेंगे?

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: इसी में कई एआई एजेंट मिलकर मदद कर सकते हैं।

object_interactions.action: lifts a transparent data cube to show how many records exist

shots.location: 3D library hall made of bookcases and digital research tables
shots.visual_explanation: A literal library with separate tables stands for agents checking different questions.
shots.learner_payoff: Divide a large task into smaller research questions.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: इसे बड़ी लाइब्रेरी समझिए। हर एजेंट अलग शेल्फ का सवाल जाँचता है।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: फिर सारे नतीजे एक जगह मिलते हैं?

object_interactions.action: hands Riya one research book from a nearby rolling cart

shots.location: 3D neuroscience laboratory with suspended mouse brain cell holograms
shots.visual_explanation: Distinct cells split into several luminous trays; this is a conceptual simulation, not human medical data.
shots.learner_payoff: The source research used data from millions of mouse brain cells.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: इस शोध में चूहों के दिमाग की लाखों कोशिकाओं का डेटा देखा गया।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: यानि यह इंसानों में इलाज का परीक्षण नहीं था।

object_interactions.action: moves the transparent cell tray to a microscope workbench

shots.location: 3D research hall with many small desks representing parallel agents
shots.visual_explanation: Camera moves between multiple tiny workstations and a combined evidence board.
shots.learner_payoff: Parallel research can connect data with literature.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: हजारों एजेंट्स ने अलग काम करके रिपोर्ट्स एक साथ जोड़ीं।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: और उन रिपोर्ट्स को वैज्ञानिकों ने परखा?

object_interactions.action: pins a small clue card onto the evidence board

shots.location: 3D lab verification bench with microscope and locked sample boxes
shots.visual_explanation: The lab bench visibly separates glowing hypothesis cards from evidence samples.
shots.learner_payoff: Thirty-two minutes is an analysis report, not a cure.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक विश्लेषण बत्तीस मिनट में हुआ।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: लेकिन अगला प्रयोग और पुष्टि तो जरूरी है।

object_interactions.action: moves a hypothesis card into the box marked for future testing

shots.location: 3D science studio with researcher desk and closing hologram
shots.visual_explanation: The learner and explainer together seal the evidence box and hold up a simple takeaway model.
shots.learner_payoff: AI can accelerate scientific leads; human tests still matter.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: एआई वैज्ञानिकों को सुराग देता है, अंतिम प्रमाण नहीं।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: मतलब तेज शोध के साथ मजबूत जाँच भी चाहिए।

object_interactions.action: closes the evidence box as the camera dollies back

episodes.title: AI Agents और Software Security: आसान 3D कहानी
episodes.viewer_question: How do AI-assisted vulnerability discoveries turn into safe software fixes without exaggerating AI capabilities?
episodes.learning_outcome: Understand five defensive security stages with a fictional team and concrete 3D actions, without exposing exploit methods.
episodes.repeatable_takeaway: Remember FIND → VERIFY → REPORT → PATCH → UPDATE; confirm affected products and update instructions using official maintainers.

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult woman, navy jacket with thin cyan piping, shoulder-length dark hair
characters.voice_style: Warm natural conversational voice with clear short explanations

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult man, navy shirt, light stubble, cyan cuff accents
characters.voice_style: Conversational Hindi male storyteller with measured pauses

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult woman, teal top, round glasses and hair bun
characters.voice_style: Curious Hindi woman raising practical questions without jargon

characters.visual_identity: South Asian adult male developer, navy vest, short hair and headset
characters.voice_style: Calm Hindi demonstrator who verifies real-world steps

shots.location: Digital 3D city at night with symbolic software towers
shots.visual_explanation: Riya notices warning lights; Kabir explains this is an illustrative security story.
shots.learner_payoff: AI can find possible weaknesses, but not all alerts are facts.

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: ये लाल रोशनी क्या बताती है, और क्या पूरा इंटरनेट खतरे में है?

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: यह सुरक्षा की एक कहानी है। हर अलर्ट असली समस्या नहीं होता।

object_interactions.action: raises a symbolic warning tower to inspect it

shots.location: 3D library of code archives and inspection desks
shots.visual_explanation: Kabir moves a searchlight along code shelves while Riya asks a beginner question.
shots.learner_payoff: An AI agent scans patterns like a fast research assistant.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: एक एजेंट को तेज लाइब्रेरी सहायक समझिए, जो कोड में संदिग्ध हिस्से खोजता है।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: लेकिन उसे पूरा संदर्भ कैसे पता चलता है?

object_interactions.action: pulls out a blue symbolic code block for closer review

shots.location: Cybersecurity lab with sandbox cubes and evidence shields
shots.visual_explanation: The trio examines abstract code cubes without depicting exploit steps or attacking systems.
shots.learner_payoff: Only authorized experts should verify findings.

dialogue.speaker: omar
dialogue.text: हम किसी दूसरे सिस्टम पर हमला नहीं करेंगे। नियंत्रित लैब में प्रमाण जाँचेंगे।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: तो खोज के बाद इंसानों की पुष्टि पहली जरूरत है।

object_interactions.action: places the code block into a sealed research sandbox

shots.location: Quality-control laboratory with red and green evidence trays
shots.visual_explanation: Riya sorts hypothesis cubes from verified evidence cubes while expert points to limitations.
shots.learner_payoff: A suspicious pattern and a confirmed flaw are not the same.

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: एक लाल सिग्नल दिखा है। क्या इसे तुरंत सच मान लें?

dialogue.speaker: omar
dialogue.text: नहीं। संस्करण, प्रभाव और वास्तविकता की स्वतंत्र पुष्टि करनी होगी।

object_interactions.action: moves an uncertain signal from the red tray to a pending review tray

shots.location: Private conference room with sealed report envelope
shots.visual_explanation: Kabir hands a sealed report to maintainers, emphasizing responsible reporting instead of public exploit details.
shots.learner_payoff: Coordinated disclosure gives maintainers a chance to fix problems.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: पुष्टि होने पर जानकारी सही मेंटेनर तक सुरक्षित तरीके से पहुँचती है।

dialogue.speaker: omar
dialogue.text: फिर वे समय रहते सुधार तैयार कर सकते हैं।

object_interactions.action: passes a sealed incident report to Omar

shots.location: 3D developer workshop with circuit boards and testing devices
shots.visual_explanation: Developer builds a symbolic patch cube and runs it through test gates.
shots.learner_payoff: Fixes need testing so old functions keep working.

dialogue.speaker: omar
dialogue.text: अब डेवलपर पैच बनाता है, और बदलाव को अलग-अलग परीक्षण से गुजारता है।

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: सुरक्षा के साथ सॉफ्टवेयर का सामान्य काम भी बचना चाहिए।

object_interactions.action: slides a repaired component into a safe test fixture

shots.location: 3D operations center with many symbolic server racks
shots.visual_explanation: Explainer tracks the patch moving to authorized operators and updates, not to random devices.
shots.learner_payoff: A released fix must still reach affected systems.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: पैच उपलब्ध होना और हर मशीन में अपडेट लगना अलग बातें हैं।

dialogue.speaker: omar
dialogue.text: हर टीम को आधिकारिक संस्करण और अपनी स्थिति देखनी चाहिए।

object_interactions.action: pushes a labeled update cartridge into a demonstration rack

shots.location: 3D office desk with projected source cards
shots.visual_explanation: Characters compare trusted maintainer guidance with a misleading alarm symbol.
shots.learner_payoff: Use the maintainer's official guidance and confirm applicability.

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: क्या हर पुरानी वेबसाइट पर यही समस्या होगी?

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: ऐसा मानना गलत है। असली उत्पाद, संस्करण और आधिकारिक सलाह देखें।

object_interactions.action: places an official-source illustration card beside a caution symbol

shots.location: Three-character 3D classroom with evidence ladder on a board
shots.visual_explanation: The entire team rearranges labels for find, verify, report, patch, update.
shots.learner_payoff: Security requires verification, permissions and human coordination.

dialogue.speaker: kabir
dialogue.text: एआई की खोज उपयोगी है, पर विशेषज्ञ और मेंटेनर्स की जिम्मेदारी बनी रहती है।

dialogue.speaker: omar
dialogue.text: बिना अनुमति परीक्षण या जल्दबाजी में खुलासा नुकसान पहुँचा सकता है।

object_interactions.action: moves a verify tile before the report tile

shots.location: Wide 3D futuristic studio with a physical five-step staircase
shots.visual_explanation: All characters move one physical step block each as the camera slowly widens.
shots.learner_payoff: Remember five steps: find, verify, report, patch, update.

dialogue.speaker: riya
dialogue.text: अब मुझे समझ आया: एआई सुराग देता है, लोग सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करते हैं।

dialogue.speaker: asha
dialogue.text: याद रखिए: खोज, पुष्टि, रिपोर्ट, पैच और अपडेट।

object_interactions.action: sets the final update block onto the safety staircase
